skeleton.accessibilityBody: Skeletons are decorative by default. Keep one visually hidden status element mounted outside the busy region before the transition, then update its text when loading begins. Put aria-busy only on the region being updated.
skeleton.usageBody: Match the final content's dimensions closely, keep the placeholder structure stable, and use Skeleton instead of one-off animated divs. Use a spinner for an action with indeterminate progress and an empty state only after loading has completed.
skeleton.classNameProp: Sets the placeholder's dimensions and shape with utility classes.
skeleton.ariaHiddenProp: Keeps the decorative placeholder out of the accessibility tree by default. Announce loading with a sibling status instead of exposing the placeholder.
